title: 第四章  旧元与新元
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“您认识我，您是？”

叶落很疑惑，自己今天才刚刚来这个学校，除了自己那个班应该没谁见过自己吧，

“废话少说，你想干什么？”，

吴旻当然不会给他好脸色，就是因为他，自己才被月魔女罚跑圈，现在才刚刚从操场回来；

“呃，你知道图书馆怎么走吗？”，

“图书馆？就在前面不远，你一直往前走，看到一座比较高大的阶梯型建筑就是了。”

“好的，谢谢”，叶落回了一礼，这让吴旻受用了不少；

叶落径直往前走，一路上看到不少学生都从这个方向回来，“看来图书馆是个好地方啊”；

“呼，终于到了，”这哪里是一点点，分明有好几公里，“不过好奇怪啊，他们可都是高手，怎么不见他们使用能力？”

叶落尽管心有疑惑，但凭借古老头送的学生卡也是顺利得进入了图书馆。

走进图书馆，位于一楼正中的一幅大字‘传说’，叶落整个人仿佛被敲了一棍，呆呆得不动了，他只感觉这幅字仿佛要将他吞没，

“小友，你怎么不动了呀？”叶落突然被惊醒，是刚刚在图书馆门口的一个黑衣老者，“这‘传说’二字，你可有什么感受？”

“我就感觉有一种恢弘的气势，它仿佛要将我吞”，叶落深吸一口气，将自己怦怦直跳的心脏舒缓吗；

“这位老伯，您知道历史专区怎么走吗？”

“来小友，我来带你去，放心，我对这图书馆可是熟悉的很。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"You know me, are you?"

Ye Luo was very confused. He had just come to this school today. No one in his class had seen him.

"Stop talking nonsense, what do you want to do?",

Of course Wu Min would not give him a good look. It was because of him that he was punished by the Moon Witch and had just returned from the playground;

"Um, do you know how to get to the library?",

"The library? It's not far ahead. Just keep walking and you'll see a taller stepped building."

"Okay, thank you", Ye Luo returned the gesture, which greatly benefited Wu Min;

Ye Luo walked straight forward and saw many students coming back from this direction along the way. "It seems that the library is a good place";

"Huh, we're finally here." This is not a little bit, it's clearly several kilometers away, "But it's so strange, they are all masters, why can't I see them using their abilities?"

Although Ye Luo had doubts, he successfully entered the library with the student card given by his old boss.

Walking into the library, Ye Luo felt as if a stick had been hit on his whole body by the large word "Legend" in the middle of the first floor. He felt as if the word was about to swallow him up.

"My little friend, why are you not moving?" Ye Luo was suddenly awakened by an old man in black who was at the door of the library just now. "How do you feel about the word 'legend'?"

"I feel like there is a magnificent momentum, it seems to swallow me up." Ye Luo took a deep breath to soothe his pounding heart;

"Old man, do you know how to get to the historical area?"

"Come on, little friend, I'll take you there. Don't worry, I'm very familiar with this library."
